rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with the provided 4BB label and image in noting a loosely grouped ICM and sparse/loose TE, but it overstates confidence about features like a well-defined blastocoel and exact herniation details that are not clearly visible in this partial image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, male factor, prior cycle, endometrium, and lifestyle reasonably well with embryo quality, though some links are somewhat generic and not all factors are weighed with equal nuance.

The reasoning is structured and generally logical, with a plausible probability range derived from embryo grade and patient factors, though some numerical adjustments appear heuristic rather than rigorously supported.

Much of the morphology discussion and general counseling are aligned with IVF practice, but recommendations such as routine aspirin, ERA after limited failure history, endometrial scratch, and strong PGT-A endorsement after one failed cycle are not strongly guideline-supported.
Provides clear next-step suggestions for transfer management and future workup, including sperm assessment and protocol review, but some recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care.
